name: Southlake Village Rehabilitation & Care Center
priceNote: Nebraska average for a nursing home (semi-private to private room). This facility does not publish its price.

inspections.title: Nurse aides missing required dementia and abuse training
inspections.detail: Ensure nurse aides have the skills they need to care for residents, and give nurse aides education in dementia care and abuse prevention.

inspections.title: Menus not meeting nutrition needs
inspections.detail: Ensure menus must meet the nutritional needs of residents, be prepared in advance, be followed, be updated, be reviewed by dietician, and meet the needs of the resident.

inspections.title: Honor the resident's right to request, refuse, and/or discontinue treatment, to participate in or refuse to participate in experimental research, and to formulate an advance directive
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to request, refuse, and/or discontinue treatment, to participate in or refuse to participate in experimental research, and to formulate an advance directive.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Poor ventilation
inspections.detail: Have enough outside ventilation via a window or mechanical ventilation, or both.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

quality.label: Needing more help with daily activities

openings.note: Estimate: certified beds minus average daily residents (CMS). Certified beds are often more than the beds actually staffed. Call to confirm.

bio: Non-profit nursing home in Lincoln with 126 certified beds, part of Vetter Senior Living. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab.
